name: @pipeworx/mcp-worldbank-projects

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search World Bank development projects by free text and/or country and status. Returns financing, sectors, lending instrument, approval/closing dates, and status for each match. Keyless. Provide query and/or country_code.

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. "rural water supply", "climate resilience", "rural electrification".

country_code.description: ISO-2 country code to filter by, e.g. "BR" (Brazil), "KE" (Kenya), "IN" (India).

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get the fuller record for a single World Bank project by its project id (e.g. "P006553", "P501648"): financing breakdown, implementing agency, borrower, sectors, themes, and the project development objective / abstract. Keyless.

id.description: World Bank project id, e.g. "P006553" or "P501648". Find ids via search_projects.

tools.name: projects_by_country
tools.description: List a country's World Bank projects (newest board-approval first) filtered by status. Returns the compact project shape with financing, sectors, and dates. Keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-worldbank-projects forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the worldbank-projects pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
